# Kanaan Gents Salon & Spa

> Premium men's grooming, barbering and spa group across 10 houses in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain, UAE. Service-led, master-trained, spa-grade hygiene. Bilingual English / Arabic.

## Brand
- Name: Kanaan Gents Salon & Spa
- Languages: English (en), Arabic (ar) — RTL
- Locale: UAE (Abu Dhabi + Al Ain)
- Booking: online (kanaanspa.ae/book.html), WhatsApp, walk-in
- Confirmation SLA: 30 minutes during open hours

## Branches (10)

- [Al Ain](/branches/al-ain.html) — neighbourhood Kanaan house, full menu
- [Khalifa City](/branches/khalifa-city.html) — modern house in Khalifa City A
- [Khalidiya](/branches/khalidiya.html) — central Abu Dhabi house
- [Baniyas Spa](/branches/baniyas-spa.html) — flagship spa house with hammam
- [Baniyas Barber](/branches/baniyas-barber.html) — master barber room
- [Rabdan](/branches/rabdan.html) — quiet, refined, full-service
- [Old Shahamah](/branches/old-shahamah.html) — classic Kanaan service
- [New Shahamah](/branches/new-shahamah.html) — contemporary house
- [Muroor](/branches/muroor.html) — easy access on Muroor Road
- [VIP Muroor](/branches/vip-muroor.html) — private suites, by appointment

## Services (7 categories)

- [Hair & Beard](/services/hair-beard.html) — haircuts, hot-towel shaves, beard sculpts (from 60 AED)
- [Facial & Skin Care](/services/facial-skin-care.html) — Express, Signature, Hydra, Anti-Fatigue, Premium (from 120 AED)
- [Massage](/services/massage.html) — Swedish, deep-tissue, sports recovery, hot stone (from 150 AED)
- [Moroccan Bath](/services/moroccan-bath.html) — traditional hammam ritual, only at Baniyas Spa + VIP Muroor (from 130 AED)
- [Manicure & Pedicure](/services/manicure-pedicure.html) — sterilised single-use tools (from 70 AED)
- [Hair Treatment](/services/hair-treatment.html) — protein, keratin, scalp therapy (from 180 AED)
- [Grooming Packages](/services/grooming-packages.html) — multi-service bundles (100, 220, 250, 320, 450 AED)

## Featured offers

- 8-Service Signature Package — 250 AED — at all branches
- 6-Service Essential Package — 100 AED — at all branches
- Moroccan Bath Ritual — 180 AED — Baniyas Spa, VIP Muroor only
- VIP Gentleman's Hour — 450 AED — VIP Muroor only
- Eid Premium Package — 320 AED — limited time
- Father & Son Ritual — 220 AED — at all branches

## Standards (consistent across all branches)

- Master-trained barbers and certified spa therapists
- Spa-grade hygiene: single-use blades, sterilised tools, sealed packs
- Professional product lines (Dermalogica family-grade and similar)
- English & Arabic service
- No rushed cuts; chair time matches the work
